blocks.content: TRAI was created to separate regulatory functions from service providers and to encourage private participation in the telecom sector.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: TRAI was established to create a clear division between service provision and regulatory oversight.
A primary objective of setting up TRAI was to foster and encourage private sector investment and participation in telecom.
The regulatory framework ensures fair competition and structured governance in the Indian telecommunications sector.
TRAI's core mandate focuses on separating regulatory duties from operational service providers.
Encouraging private sector participation in telecommunications is a frequently asked objective of TRAI's establishment.
